results.title: Reunion
results.overview: When a group of friends comes together for an evening, they’re in for a shock as their host unveils her plan: resurrecting her dead twin sister.

results.title: A Future on Stage
results.overview: A documentary on the making of the Broadway and West End musical stage adaptation of Back to the Future.

results.title: Hidden Beach
results.overview: After an argument with his father, Tomás (26) leaves with his best friend Lucas (25) and other members of the ballet company to the family’s beach house. While living in Playa Escondida, Tomás indulges his desires by paying local men for casual sex, while also uncovering secrets about his family. When he decides to resume his career as a dancer, his activities are discovered, and his life takes a violent turn.

results.title: MUGA
results.overview: In MUGA, world-renowned climber Ashima Shiraishi steps into the ancient granite of Switzerland’s Ticino Valley, where every hold and ripple in the rock tells a story millions of years in the making.  As the boundaries between self and stone dissolve, she enters muga—a liminal state free from attachment, expectation, and desire.  Here she finds the space not just to climb, but simply to be.

results.title: Don't Let Me Die
results.overview: The corpse of a woman is found in front of Maria’s apartment window. She agrees to take charge of the funeral, becoming involved in her neighbour’s existence. Maria adopts the woman’s unattended dogs and forms a bond with her estranged son. After the burial, Maria tries to reclaim her own life back, but a haunting feeling lingers.

results.title: Ratgirl
results.overview: Ratgirl, a diffident 19 year-old woman, as she and her older roommate Alice discover their apartment is infested with rats — a claim which is adamantly ignored by their miserly landlord. Over the course of a hellish fourty-eight hours, Ratgirl unconfidently navigates sexual harassment, housing instability, ex-friendships, and suppressed mental illness.

results.title: Reef Builders
results.overview: "Reef Builders" tells the true stories of people involved in the Sheba Hope Grows program, leading major restorations to save the world’s coral reefs in the face of climate change.

results.title: Fights Break Sphere 4: Escape
results.overview: After preventing a war between the Snake Tribe and the Human Clan, Xiao Yan embarks on a journey to strengthen his powers with his companions. Along the way, he prepares for a crucial duel with a powerful rival, but their quest takes a dark turn when Qinglin is suddenly abducted in the Tagore Desert.

results.title: Amsterdam Vigilance
results.overview: Gabe, a British film student who, after a brutal robbery in Amsterdam, decides to uncover the truth behind a mysterious masked avenger. What begins as a documentary ends in a nightmare of violence, betrayal, and obsession.

results.title: When the Blood Flows
results.overview: In Ipanema, a couple of vampires seduce their victims with promises of sexual encounters through letters. But their lives are turned upside down when a stranger, fascinated by the idea of anthropophagy, replies to one of their letters, leading to an unlikely outcome.

results.title: The Salt
results.overview: The whole family gathers to clear out the house of the dying grandfather. After spending hours packing boxes, they get a call from the hospital – he’s doing better. Everyone seems thrilled to hear the news, except for Louise, the granddaughter, as she is convinced that he is dead.

results.title: 22 Lengths
results.overview: Tilda's days are strictly structured: she studies, works at the supermarket checkout and looks after her little sister Ida - on some days she also has to look after her alcoholic mother. But this summer brings a change: Tilda receives a promising job offer for a doctorate in Berlin. Viktor also turns up, who, like her, always swims 22 laps in the swimming pool. When Tilda begins to believe that everything could be better, the situation at home spirals out of control.

results.title: Illusions
results.overview: This is a story about love—the kind we chase, the kind we settle for, and the kind that sneaks up on us when we’re not paying attention. It’s about permanence, or the lack of it, and the terrifying realisation that maybe nothing in life—no feeling, no relationship—ever truly stays the same.  Alisa Melikova’s debut film Illusions (2025) is a rich tapestry of emotions, following two couples whose lives have been entwined for 50 years. It poses the question: Is love real, or just a story we tell ourselves? And in the end, does it even matter?

results.title: Put Your Soul on Your Hand and Walk
results.original_title: Put your soul on your hand and walk
results.overview: An Iranian filmmaker participates in a series of video calls with a young Palestinian photojournalist who describes her life confined in Gaza during the current regional conflict.

results.title: Family At Large
results.overview: The story follows an estranged father, nicknamed Reindeer, who is involved in a gruelling human trafficking run on China’s northeaster border with a young pregnant woman and a boy who has been kidnapped before.

results.title: King Of Lies: Football's Trillion Dollar Con
results.original_title: King Of Lies: Football's Trillion Dollar Con
results.overview: A stranger-than-fiction caper, a man who gained influence over a London bank, charmed senior figures in British football and government and fronted a deal with North Korea.

results.title: Two Sisters
results.overview: Two sisters set out from Warsaw to Kharkiv to pick up their seriously injured father.
